title: set_tips and advance_tips build SQL with format!() dynamic placeholders — fragile pattern
description: sqlite_storage.rs set_tips and advance_tips build multi-row INSERT/DELETE SQL by string-formatting repeated '(?, ?)' or '?' placeholders via .join(). This pattern is not obviously safe to new contributors and cannot be checked by sqlx's compile-time query macros. The approach is correct but fragile — a refactor touching the loop could miscount binds vs placeholders silently. Consider a helper function or use sqlx::QueryBuilder (which handles multi-row batching with compile-time safety).
